V. 44.
And being in an agony—Probably juſt now grappling with the Powers of Darkneſs; feeling the Weight of the Wrath of GOD, and at the ſame Time ſurrounded with a mighty Hoſt of Devils, who exerciſed all their Force and Malice to perſecute and diſtract his wounded Spirit. He prayed more earneſtly—Even with ſtronger Cries and Tears: And his ſweat—As cold as the Weather was: Was as it were great drops of blood—Which, by the vehement Diſireſs of his Soul, were forced out of the Pores, in ſo great a Quantity, as afterwards united in large, thick, grumous Drops, and even fell to the ground.
